mapper.select: SELECT cat.code, t.code AS topic_code, cat.name, cat.description, cat.sort_order FROM category cat JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id WHERE cat.enabled = TRUE AND t.enabled = TRUE AND t.code = #{topicCode} ORDER BY cat.sort_order ASC, cat.id ASC
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM category cat JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id WHERE cat.code = #{code} AND cat.enabled = TRUE AND t.enabled = TRUE )

where.if: AND (cat.code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cat.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT cat.code, t.code AS topic_code, cat.name, cat.description, cat.sort_order, cat.enabled, TO_CHAR(cat.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS updated_at FROM category cat JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id
ORDER BY cat.sort_order ASC, cat.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category cat JOIN topic t ON t.id = cat.topic_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (code, topic_id, name, description, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{code}, (SELECT id FROM topic WHERE code = #{topicCode}), #{name}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET topic_id = (SELECT id FROM topic WHERE code = #{topicCode}), name = #{name}, description = #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM category WHERE code = #{code})
